roles.description: Lead a team of 7 engineers on ChatLLM's core agentic infrastructure, serving 400k+ users: architected a task-classified model router across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini (45% fewer LLM calls per turn), shipped the chat-to-agent hand-off now routing 31k conversations a week, and cut input-token spend by ~$1.5M a year through prompt caching. Also launched two 0-to-1 verticals: Health Expert, a mobile-first wearables product with full iOS and Android clients that reached 1,000 connected users in two weeks, and Role Play, an AI character chat product whose dedicated stack cut cost per reply by over 90%.

Built automation workflows using OCR, PDF parsing, and deterministic similarity scoring to generate manufacturer sales quotes from unstructured documents and images. Designed a dogfood data pipeline to measure LLM accuracy on inventory translation against real orders.
